item.title: When a Black Newspaper Goes Quiet
item.description: The closing of the Richmond Free Press marks more than the end of a newspaper. It marks the quieting of a civic institution. Founded in 1992 by Raymond H. Boone Sr., the Richmond Free Press was created to provide independent, accountable journalism for Black Richmond. Boone brought deep professional grounding to that mission. Before launching […] The post When a Black Newspaper Goes Quiet appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Don Lemon pleads not guilty to federal charges stemming from church protest
item.description: Don Lemon pleaded not guilty to federal charges stemming from his presence at a protest at a St. Paul, Minnesota, church last month, and has vowed to fight the charges, saying they are an attempt to silence him and other journalists. The post Don Lemon pleads not guilty to federal charges stemming from church protest appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Putting God First: Building a Marriage and a Business
item.description: Bernard and Pamela Solomon, a couple married for nearly 34 years, have built a life rooted in faith, family, and service, and have now become franchise owners of AtWork in Forest Park. The post Putting God First: Building a Marriage and a Business appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Divas, Blues, and Memories’: Artist Chronicles LGBTQ History Through Button-Encrusted Art
item.description: "Beau McCall: Divas, Blues, and Memories" is an exhibition at the Hammonds House Museum that celebrates the healing power of music and the LGBTQ community, featuring button-encrusted collages that pay tribute to friends lost to AIDS and other social ills. The post ‘Divas, Blues, and Memories’: Artist Chronicles LGBTQ History Through Button-Encrusted Art appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Atlanta United will begin 2026 on the road
item.description: Atlanta United revealed their new Spirit of '96 kit at the Delta Flight Museum, paying homage to the 1996 Summer Olympic Games, with former goalkeeper Brad Guzan and Olympic legends Edwin Moses and Shannon Miller modeling the kit. The post Atlanta United will begin 2026 on the road appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: APS educators visit The Atlanta Voice to talk journalism, trends in media
item.description: Atlanta Public Schools AVTF teachers visited The Atlanta Voice to discuss the importance of local journalism and how to work together to promote reading and media literacy among students. item.title: ‘Reverend Jackson was my superhero’: Jesse Jackson: 1941-2026
item.description: Civil rights activist and icon, Jesse Jackson, passed away at the age of 84, leaving behind a legacy of Black pride and excellence, as well as the Rainbow PUSH Coalition, which continues to advocate for voting rights, social programs, and civil rights. The post ‘Reverend Jackson was my superhero’: Jesse Jackson: 1941-2026 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘This race is not about party labels’: Duncan gets endorsed by former Georgia NAACP President Woodall
item.description: Former Georgia NAACP President James Woodall, Sr. has endorsed Geoff Duncan for Governor of Georgia, citing his ability to win in November and his commitment to strategy and courage. The post ‘This race is not about party labels’: Duncan gets endorsed by former Georgia NAACP President Woodall appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘When HIStory Was Watching’ event highlights Civil Rights and legacies
item.description: At the "When HIStory Was Watching" event, Ambassador Andrew Young, Atlanta Mayor Andre Dickens, and other legacy families, archivists, and civic leaders discussed the importance of preserving and protecting civil rights archives and the legacy of Ernest C. Withers' 1.8 million images documenting the movement. The post ‘When HIStory Was Watching’ event highlights Civil Rights and legacies appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: 9to5 Georgia leads ‘Advocacy Day’ for paid leave at State Capitol
item.description: 9to5 Georgia hosted an advocacy day at the Georgia State Capitol to support paid leave, emphasizing the need for comprehensive leave policies that cover all workers and urging legislators to fund an actuarial study to explore workable solutions.
